channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Logical Take: The Rise of Responsible Influencers, Why India Needs More Food Pharmers
item.description: Responsible influencers are transforming India’s digital landscape by choosing factual accountability and public interest over viral sensationalism.

item.title: ‘Vague and Divisive’: Supreme Court Freezes UGC’s 2026 Equity Rules, Calls for Rethink
item.description: The apex court has paused UGC’s new equity regulations, citing lack of clarity and potential misuse, while keeping 2012 rules in force.

item.title: Economic Survey Warns of ‘Alarming’ Obesity Rise, Calls for Day-Long Ban on Ultra-Processed Food Ads
item.description: The Economic Survey warns that rising obesity, driven by ultra-processed foods and sedentary lifestyles, demands urgent regulatory action.

item.title: Trump Threatens 50% Tariff on Canadian Aircraft Sold in US, Warns of Bombardier Jet Decertification
item.description: US President Donald Trump warns of sweeping aircraft tariffs and decertification unless Canada clears US-made Gulfstream jets, deepening bilateral trade tensions.

item.title: Economic Survey 2026 Highlights: 10 Big Takeaways That Reveal Where India’s Economy Is Headed
item.description: India’s Economic Survey 2026 reports strong GDP growth and record low inflation amid global economic uncertainty

item.title: ‘No Security Risks’: Bangladesh Clears Shooting Team for India Meet Despite Pulling Out of T20 World Cup
item.description: Bangladesh clears its shooting team for Delhi trip despite boycotting the T20 World Cup over security.

item.title: Tragedy Turns Lifesaving in Andhra Pradesh as Guntur’s 22-Year-Old Student Saves Six Lives Through Organ Donation
item.description: After a fatal road accident, a 22-year-old engineering student’s organ donation in Guntur transformed tragedy into hope for six families across Andhra Pradesh.

item.title: Worried About AI Taking Your Job? Economic Survey 2026 Reveals Which Jobs Could Survive Artificial Intelligence
item.description: Economic Survey 2025-26 identifies high-skill manual and empathy-based roles as resilient against the future AI-led job disruptions.

item.title: J&K: Mobile Internet Suspended in Three Kishtwar Areas as Security Tightens During Ongoing Search Operations
item.description: Authorities have suspended mobile data in three areas of Kishtwar while security forces track a group of terrorists in the snow-bound Chatroo forest.

item.title: People of Purpose: From Nirbhaya to Unnao, Yogita Bhayana’s PARI Fights Rape in India
item.description: She left a secure aviation career to stand with survivors. Today, through PARI, she fights rape and systemic failure across India.
